sections.title: What transfers and how to time your move
sections.body: Moving accounting systems requires planning. You can export your customer details, vendor lists and inventory items from your current software and import them into Paper & Pen. However, historical invoices, receipts and past journal entries do not transfer automatically. You must keep your old records for tax compliance. The most practical time to switch is at the start of a new financial year. You can close your books in your old system, export your closing balances, and enter them as opening balances in Paper & Pen.
items: Export your customer and vendor lists
Keep your old software for historical records
Start your new system at financial year end

sections.title: Tools for physical products and growing teams
sections.body: Many businesses start with simple service invoices. As you grow, your needs change. Paper & Pen provides a free sales and invoicing core, but adds the ability to track physical stock and costs. You can issue delivery notes, purchase orders and quotations. If you hire staff, you can add our paid HR and payroll module. If you start producing goods, you can add the paid manufacturing module. You also gain a multilingual interface, allowing your team to work in English, Arabic, Hindi, Bengali or Urdu.
items: Track your physical stock levels and costs
Issue purchase orders and professional delivery notes
Add paid HR and payroll modules later
Right-to-left Arabic and Urdu text support

sections.title: Who should not switch to Paper & Pen
sections.body: Paper & Pen is not the right fit for everyone. If you run a service business that relies heavily on automatic bank feeds to categorise expenses, you should stay where you are. We do not offer bank feeds or open banking connections. If you require a dedicated mobile app from an app store, you will not find one here. Wave is an established product with its own paid subscriptions and features. Please check their website for their current capabilities. If their tools already match your exact workflow, there is no need to migrate.
items: Businesses needing automatic bank feed connections
Users who require native mobile applications
Service freelancers with absolutely no physical inventory
Companies needing third-party app marketplace integrations

faqs.q: Can I import my old invoices into Paper & Pen?
faqs.a: No, historical documents like past invoices, receipts and bills do not import into your new account. Accounting systems format transaction data differently. You will need to download your historical data from your previous software and store it securely for your financial records. When you start with Paper & Pen, you only bring over your opening balances, customer lists, vendor details and item catalogues.

Our core sales and invoicing features are free forever. This includes creating invoices, quotations, receipts, and tracking stock. We charge for advanced add-on modules like HR and payroll, or manufacturing and bills of materials. This allows you to start for free and only pay when your business requires complex operational tools.

faqs.q: How do I handle open invoices during a switch?
faqs.a: You have two choices for open invoices. You can leave them in your old system and record the payments there until they clear. Alternatively, you can recreate the unpaid invoices manually in Paper & Pen so all your expected revenue is in one place. Most businesses find it easier to collect pending payments in the old system before fully cutting over.

faqs.q: Does Paper & Pen connect to my bank account?
faqs.a: No, we do not offer automatic bank feeds or open banking integrations. You must enter your expenses and post your journal entries manually. If automatic bank imports are a critical part of your daily bookkeeping routine, you should carefully consider if moving away from your current setup is the right choice for your business.
